en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped spa garden with curved paths, flowerbeds, rows of white chairs, and a grand building in the background set against a forested hillside. The central building has a hipped roof with a clock and decorative crown-like feature on top, arched windows, and a balcony. The foreground shows a formal lawn and seating area typical of a European spa town. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner.
